text_en: When Jesus had come down from the mountain, great crowds followed him;
text_cn: 耶稣从山上下来，有许多群众跟随他。

text_en: and there was a leper who came to him and knelt before him, saying, “Lord, if you choose, you can make me clean. ”
text_cn: 看，有一个癞病人前来叩拜耶稣说：“主！你若愿意，就能洁净我。”

text_en: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I do choose. Be made clean! ” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
text_cn: 耶稣就伸手抚摸他说：“我愿意，你洁净了吧！”他的癞病立刻就洁净了。

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “See that you say nothing to anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“小心，不要对任何人说！但去叫司祭检验你，献上梅瑟所规定的礼物，给他们当做证据。”

text_en: When he entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, appealing to him
text_cn: 耶稣进了葛法翁，有一位百夫长来到他跟前，求他说：

text_en: and saying, “Lord, my servant is lying at home paralyzed, in terrible distress. ”
text_cn: “主！我的仆人瘫痪了，躺在家里，疼痛的很厉害。”

text_en: And he said to him, “I will come and cure him. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“我去治好他。”

text_en: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof; but only speak the word, and my servant will be healed.
text_cn: 百夫长答说：“主！我不堪当你到舍下来，你只要说一句话，我的仆人就会好的。

text_en: For I also am a man under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to one, ‘Go, ’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come, ’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this, ’ and the slave does it. ”
text_cn: 因为我虽是属人权下的人，但是我也有士兵属我权下；我对这个说：你去，他就去；对另一个说：你来，他就来；对我的奴仆说：你作这个，他就作。”

text_en: When Jesus heard him, he was amazed and said to those who followed him, “Truly I tell you, in no one in Israel have I found such faith.
text_cn: 耶稣听了，非常诧异，就对跟随的人说：“我实在告诉你们：在以色列我从未遇见过一个人，有这样大的信心。

text_en: I tell you, many will come from east and west and will eat with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven,
text_cn: 我给你们说：将有许多人从东方和西方来，同亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯在天国里一起坐席；

text_en: while the heirs of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth. ”
text_cn: 本国的子民，反要被驱逐到外边黑暗里；那里要有哀号和切齿。”

text_en: And to the centurion Jesus said, “Go; let it be done for you according to your faith. ” And the servant was healed in that hour.
text_cn: 耶稣遂对百夫长说：“你回去，就照你所信的，给你成就吧！”仆人就在那时刻痊愈了。

text_en: When Jesus entered Peter’s house, he saw his mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever;
text_cn: 耶稣来到伯多禄家里，看见伯多禄的岳母躺着发烧，

text_en: he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve him.
text_cn: 就摸了她的手，热症就从她身上退了。她便起来伺候他。

text_en: That evening they brought to him many who were possessed with demons; and he cast out the spirits with a word, and cured all who were sick.
text_cn: 到了晚上，人们给他送来了许多附魔的人，他一句话就驱逐了恶神；治好了一切有病的人。

text_en: This was to fulfill what had been spoken through the prophet Isaiah, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases. ”
text_cn: 这样，就应验了那藉依撒意亚先知所说的话：“他承受我们的脆弱，担荷了我们的疾病。”

text_en: Now when Jesus saw great crowds around him, he gave orders to go over to the other side.
text_cn: 耶稣看见许多群众围着自己，就吩咐往对岸去。

text_en: A scribe then approached and said, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go. ”
text_cn: 有一位经师前来，对他说：“师傅，你不论往哪里去，我要跟随你。”

text_en: And Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head. ”
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“狐狸有穴，天上的飞鸟有巢，但是人子却没有枕头的地方。”

text_en: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father. ”
text_cn: 门徒中有一个对他说：“主，请许我先去埋葬我的父亲。”

text_en: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你跟随我吧！任凭死人去埋葬他们的死人！”

text_en: And when he got into the boat, his disciples followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣上了船，他的门徒跟随着他。

text_en: A windstorm arose on the sea, so great that the boat was being swamped by the waves; but he was asleep.
text_cn: 忽然海里起了大震荡，以致那船为浪所掩盖，耶稣却睡着了。

text_en: And they went and woke him up, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing! ”
text_cn: 他们遂前来唤醒他说：“主！救命啊！我们要丧亡了。”

text_en: And he said to them, “Why are you afraid, you of little faith? ” Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a dead calm.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“小信德的人啊！你们为什么胆怯？”就起来叱责风和海，遂大为平静。

text_en: They were amazed, saying, “What sort of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him? ”
text_cn: 那些人惊讶说：“这是怎样的一个人呢？竟连风和海也听从他！”

text_en: When he came to the other side, to the country of the Gadarenes, two demoniacs coming out of the tombs met him. They were so fierce that no one could pass that way.
text_cn: 耶稣来到对岸加达辣人的地方，有两个附魔的人从坟墓里走出，向他走来；他们异常凶猛，以致没有人能从那条路上经过。

text_en: Suddenly they shouted, “What have you to do with us, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time? ”
text_cn: 他们喊说：“天主子，我们与你有什么相干？时期还没有到，你就来这里苦害我们吗？”

text_en: Now a large herd of swine was feeding at some distance from them.
text_cn: 离他们很远，有一大群猪正在牧放。

text_en: The demons begged him, “If you cast us out, send us into the herd of swine. ”
text_cn: 魔鬼恳求耶稣说：“你若驱逐我们，就赶我们进入猪群吧！”

text_en: And he said to them, “Go! ” So they came out and entered the swine; and suddenly, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and perished in the water.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“去吧！”魔鬼就出来进入猪内；忽然全群猪从山崖上直冲入海，死在水里。

text_en: The swineherds ran off, and on going into the town, they told the whole story about what had happened to the demoniacs.
text_cn: 放猪的便逃走，来到城里，把这一切和附魔人的事都报告了。

text_en: Then the whole town came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their neighborhood.
text_cn: 全城的人就出来会见耶稣，一见了他，就求他离开他们的境界。
